title: Track A — CAD-inference response (POST /v1/predictions/cad-tabular)
description: Success response for the cross-sectional CAD-classification inference endpoint. Every field listed in 'required' is mandatory: a response missing any of them fails contract validation in CI (Phase 0 §8.6, §R2-6.4). The response names the target, the model artifacts, the validation status, the explanation and the provenance; it contains no risk horizon, no alert level, no treatment suggestion and no per-patient confidence interval.

audit_id.description: Audit identifier of this inference. A replayed request returns the ORIGINAL audit_id and creates no second audit event (Phase 0 §R2-6.1).

idempotent_replay.description: true when this response is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key and an identical canonical payload. The rest of the body is byte-identical to the original response.

calibration_id.description: Calibration artifact id, or 'none' when the model is served uncalibrated. A model with calibration_id 'none' MUST serve score.type 'uncalibrated_score' (Phase 0 §R2-5.5).

explanation_config_id.description: Versioned explanation configuration (method, scale, and for LIME the fixed seed and sampling count).

model_performance_ref.description: Pointer to the model-card section that matches the current validation_status. A model whose status is development_internal_only may only point at the internal-validation section; an external-validation reference must not exist before external validation is completed (Phase 0 §R2-6.4).

missing_features.description: Optional features that were not supplied and are handled by the versioned preprocessing pipeline (imputation). Identity-critical features are never silently imputed: they are required and yield 422 missing_required_feature.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notices, e.g. a value outside the training range or an imputed optional feature.

then.description: A MOCK_ONLY feature schema can never be served as a production payload: a response scored against a mock schema must declare data_class MOCK_SYNTHETIC, so no consumer can mistake it for a clinically approved result.
